FieldSet.description: Reuses the LFRDN-342 AF_Document__mdt engine so the refund evidence AF_VR_CreditNote_EvidenceRequired only checks as a typed text field also requires a genuinely attached file before the approval-submit flow (AF_FL_CreditNote_SubmitApproval) fires - same tightening already applied to Payment proof under LFRDN-341. The condition here is unconditional (matches Handover's pattern), so no fields are strictly required by a branch yet; AF_RefundPath__c is exposed for a future path-specific split if the business ever wants Refund vs Credit Retained to require different evidence.
FieldSet.label: AF Document Condition Fields
